target: Head-on sumo ring-outs on the local pre-attack sprint MMC preset. Legal feature is a single Jump key decision at eligible grounded, forward-moving input heads. Plain W-tap handles the remaining controls.
rationale: In the native recoil audit a grounded player could cancel incoming horizontal travel through contact before movement. Earlier jump-every-impact trials produced sprint takeoffs but the benefit changed with timing, including lost boxing maintenance. Isolate when a grounded sprint takeoff is worth its airborne exposure.
model_validation_calendars: Eight new W-tap mirror recordings identified by sumorl1-clock requests, each used whole. Open after freezing policy. Development and evaluation never share a donor match.

training.reward: mean regulation ring-out score (win 1, draw or timeout 0.5, loss 0), equal weight per opponent. CEM stochastic policy search with common scenarios within generation.

native_plan: Both seats and RTTs. MMC sumo 4 repeats per cell against W-tap, 2 each against Hold-W and trade-W-tap. Hypixel-like sumo 1 per cell vs W-tap. MMC 20-second boxing maintenance drill 2 per cell with 2-second defender click handicap. Identical settings in control arm. Independent native runs. No final humans recruited or used.
promotion: No promotion without ring-out gains vs plain W-tap in native and model across RTTs, inspect opponent and seat spread, and inspect shared-state maintenance at 3/5/10. Report inactivity (2 windows +100ms), upgrades, censoring and missed windows. Native elite-human performance requires a separately sealed evaluation. All prior opponent policies are development or diagnostic baselines.
